generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent production weapon atlas for the original dimensional fantasy game Moonlit Beacon. Create EXACTLY six separate weapons in a regular 2-column by 3-row equal-cell atlas, generous fully transparent padding, no text or grid. Each weapon is shown alone, no hands/characters/ground shadows, entire silhouette uncut. All six point horizontally RIGHT: grip/handle at left, blade/barrel/tip at right. Consistent three-quarter top-down RPG camera, elegant smooth painted anime 2.5D metal/leather/brass material shading, strong readable silhouette, softly lit upper left, restrained colored accents, no large aura or particles. Intended to be drawn tiny next to a 3-head-tall painted hero. Not pixel art, no blocky lines.
Cell order row 1: left Warden's curved moon-silver sword with a small blue guard and wrapped navy grip, clear curved blade; right Dancer's matched pair of short silver fang daggers placed parallel one above the other, violet guard accents. Row 2: left Keeper's compact amber brass lantern pistol, short flared bell barrel and a warm glass lantern chamber above the grip; right Knight's stout silver/brass ring cannon, a broad circular muzzle aperture at the right tip, visibly heavy short barrel and blue metal accent. Row 3: left Eclipse's short crescent reaper weapon, dark violet staff/haft horizontally oriented left to right ending in an elegant silver crescent blade curling around the right tip, controlled violet gem; right Sage's long slim celestial needle rifle, moon-silver barrel, star-shaped sight bead, dark teal stock and small cyan inlay. All are original ornate fantasy equipment, no real brands or modern real firearms. Fill roughly 70 percent of each cell width with consistent scale; do not overlap cells. Preserve true alpha transparency outside the six weapons, no checkerboard, matte, labels, watermark, UI, borders or extra objects. Readable material volume and silhouette matter more than microscopic filigree.

note: Generated with the built-in image tool for the 4.0.0 painted weapon integration.
